version.value: Flute version of the concerto; complete finale only
version.note: Only movement III is hosted in this package. Set metadata records part 3 of 3, not possession of the preceding Allegro di molto and Largo. The 1755 date belongs to the original organ concerto Wq 34; the flute adaptation is later and cannot be assigned a precise year. The working manuscript is dated between 1755 and 1768 by Kuijken. The recording’s performing edition, any restored missing bar and the details of a cadenza are unestablished. The modern critical performing parts clarify the manuscript’s shorthand: flute participates in the opening and closing tutti, so a blank flute staff does not establish a rest. These parts are consulted as a reference, not attributed to the 2008 performance or claimed to be public domain. The score-derived orchestra display uses passage overviews rather than aligned entries; the cello desk represents written basso, not a verified allocation of bass instruments.

performers.note: Both sources name the soloist and ensemble. The opened programme does not identify a conductor for this concerto or its continuo player. Credits for soloists in the adjacent Brandenburg concertos have not been transferred to this track. Exact string numbers, keyboard type, double-bass participation and tuning are unestablished.

date.note: Commons gives February 2008 and the upstream Music of the Bach Family programme gives 10 and 17 February. The source does not identify which concert supplies this performance or whether material was combined. The directory’s 7 April 2008 file timestamps and Commons’ 23 November 2008 upload are not session dates. MAR-08 is a repository folder name, not proof of a March performance.

place.note: The opened recording page, concert programme and notes do not identify the recording venue. The orchestra’s usual location does not establish this session’s place.

label.note: The Al Goldstein/Pandora collection is a digital repository, not evidence of a commercial record label. No original carrier imprint is identified.

catalogue.note: No commercial catalogue number is documented. The repository filename 6_CPE_Bach_Concerto_Gmaj_Presto.ogg identifies a digital item, not a record catalogue.

matrixTakeSides.note: No matrix, take, master or side identifiers are supplied. The original recording medium is not established, so this field is not declared inherently inapplicable.

credits.note: Commons credits the Al Goldstein collection as the repository source and Graham87 as uploader. Neither is explicitly identified as the recording or mastering engineer for this performance.

date.note: No recording-to-digital transfer or encoding date is established. Repository modification, upload and Commons transcode dates are not substituted.

processing.note: Commons lists Xiph.Org libVorbis I 20020717 as encoder software; that version string is not the session date. Microphone placement, original session format, editing, noise reduction and mastering are unknown. No alteration to the source audio is authored in this package.

composition.note: Bach died in 1788 and IMSLP identifies the historical manuscript as public domain. This term-based conclusion concerns the original composition, not copyright in an unidentified modern performing edition.

recording.note: Commons explicitly licenses this sound recording under CC BY-SA 2.0 and describes its upstream EFF Open Audio License origin. The nominated source is retained. The historical upstream Read.html licence link now returns 404 after redirect, so independent current retrieval of that original statement is unavailable; the explicit Commons recording licence remains the documented acceptance basis. No non-commercial restriction appears on the opened recording page or programme.

sources.title: C. P. E. Bach: The Complete Works — Wq 169 performing parts
